english: Killing an enemy of the <link Elite Tier or higher [#CombatantClassifications] /> grants 'Ascendant Escape'. This buff grants <void Invisibility /> for 5.5+2.75 seconds when you reach Critical Health or take damage while at Critical Health.

source.text:
4 Piece | Ascendant Escape

On Elite+ Kill:
Grants Ascendant Escape.

Ascendant Escape: Upon reaching Critical Health or being damaged while at Critical Health:
Invisibility for 5.5+2.75 seconds.
